ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation background across both lobes, overlaid with a dense network of thin white linear features and scattered small white point-source highlights.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 105 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:5 relative to the central fluke area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with distinct peaks and valleys exhibiting a vertical amplitude of approximately 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward and outward sweep from the median notch, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, circular white pixel clusters primarily located in the mid-lower regions of the right and left lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive and clear detection of multiple, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) spanning the majority of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface and a prominent jagged edge on the trailing margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights and water wash at the base where the fluke meets the water surface.
